findings.title: Required owner decisions O217-1 through O217-7 remain unresolved
findings.details: The contract explicitly blocks all implementation and release publication on seven authenticated owner decisions: O217-1 canonical manager repository and exact gitlink/package path plus authorized child repositories; O217-2 the supported-platform matrix (OS, architecture, shell, artifact, per-user install dir, PATH entry, CI runner); O217-3 default logical-tier request behavior while the recorded medium/default Kimi route is decommissioned; O217-4 the complete deterministic signing authority, trust root, key-lifecycle, and canonical-signed-representation contract; O217-5 the exact stale launcher binding and canonical replacement target; O217-6 the manifest-freshness/expiration policy; and O217-7 the single-file-only versus signed-archive admission contract. None are resolved. The only owner-associated comment (id 4962607317) is truncated and, per the issue's own rule and trusted policy, comments do not supply owner authorization. Without these answers the specification cannot establish a single executable owner lane or objective final acceptance. Consistent with the issue's durable-blocked-state clause, it carries df:ask-owner (in addition to P1) and does not carry df:reviewed, so it must remain blocked and is not review-clean. Obtain complete authenticated answers for every applicable decision and re-review the resulting exact issue version.

findings.title: Blocking dependency chain lacks trusted exact-revision evidence
findings.details: The contract makes #253, #260, and #275 blocking dependencies and requires that, before CLI/TUI implementation or release integration is admitted, evidence identify the exact merged default-branch revision, prove required checks green, and bind #217 validation to the consumed revisions. Trusted verified state establishes only issue #217's current version and that the default branch is main; it does not prove any dependency's merged revision, green checks, ancestry, or consumed-revision binding. The open-issue index records #253 and #275 as still open, and #275 itself depends on #253/#260, so the chain is not demonstrably complete. Issue text, comments, referenced-issue bodies, or claimed completion are insufficient. Provide trusted exact-revision evidence for each dependency and bind #217 validation to those revisions before admitting implementation or release integration.
